name: CONDITION_NOT
help: True when the child condition is false. The child condition must have a lower entry id than this condition.
description: NOT — true when the child is false

name: CONDITION_OR
help: True when any of the 2-4 child conditions is true. The child conditions must have lower entry ids than this condition.

name: CONDITION_AND
help: True when all of the 2-4 child conditions are true. The child conditions must have lower entry ids than this condition.

name: CONDITION_NONE
help: Empty condition, always met.

name: CONDITION_AURA
help: The target unit has an aura of the given spell and effect index.

name: CONDITION_ITEM
help: The target player has at least the given amount of the item in their inventory. The count must be at least 1.

name: CONDITION_ITEM_EQUIPPED
help: The target player has the item equipped (a socketed gem with this id also counts).

name: CONDITION_AREAID
help: The checked object (source if provided, otherwise target) is in the given zone or area — the id matches either its zone id or its subarea id. Mode 1 inverts the check.

name: CONDITION_REPUTATION_RANK_MIN
help: The target player's reputation rank with the faction is at least the given rank.

name: CONDITION_TEAM
help: The target player (or corpse) belongs to the given team. Always true for referring-loot checks when two-side auction interaction is enabled.

name: CONDITION_SKILL
help: The target player has the skill and its base value is at least the given value (1 to the server's max skill value).
description: {target} {negate:has|does not have} skill {pram1} at {pram2} or more

name: CONDITION_QUESTREWARDED
help: The target player has completed the quest and received its reward.

name: CONDITION_QUESTTAKEN
help: The target player currently has the quest in their quest log, optionally in a specific state.

name: CONDITION_AD_COMMISSION_AURA
help: The target player has an Argent Dawn commission trinket aura active (detected by spell visual). No parameters.
description: {target} {negate:has|does not have} an Argent Dawn commission aura

name: CONDITION_PVP_RANK
help: Reserved for vanilla — on this core the condition always evaluates to false.

name: CONDITION_ACTIVE_GAME_EVENT
help: The given game_event is currently active. Needs no source or target.

name: CONDITION_AREA_FLAG
help: The area of the checked object (source if provided, otherwise target) has all of the required flags and none of the forbidden flags. At least one of the two masks must be set.
description: area of {sourceortarget} {negate:has|does not have} flags {pram1} (and not {pram2})

name: CONDITION_RACE_CLASS
help: The target unit matches the race mask and the class mask. A mask of 0 means 'any', but at least one of the two must be set.

name: CONDITION_LEVEL
help: Compares the target unit's level with the given value.

name: CONDITION_SPELL
help: The target player knows (or, with mode 1, does not know) the given spell.

name: CONDITION_INSTANCE_SCRIPT
help: Asks the instance script of the current map (taken from the target or source) whether the script-specific condition id is met. The meaning of the id is hardcoded per instance script. The second value is unused on this core.

name: CONDITION_QUESTAVAILABLE
help: The target player can currently take the quest (level, prerequisites, and so on). Used e.g. for loot or gossip that should only be possible while the player can start the quest.

name: CONDITION_ACHIEVEMENT
help: The target player has (or, with mode 1, does not have) the achievement.

name: CONDITION_ACHIEVEMENT_REALM
help: The realm has (or, with mode 1, does not have) completed the achievement. Needs no source or target.

name: CONDITION_QUEST_NONE
help: The target player neither has the quest in progress nor has been rewarded for it.
description: quest {pram1} {negate:was never|was} taken or rewarded by {target}

name: CONDITION_ITEM_WITH_BANK
help: The target player has at least the given amount of the item in their inventory or bank. The count must be at least 1.
description: {target} {negate:has|does not have} {pram2}x {pram1} in inventory or bank

name: CONDITION_ACTIVE_HOLIDAY
help: The given holiday (Holidays.dbc) is currently active. Preferred over 'Game event active' when possible. Needs no source or target.

name: CONDITION_LEARNABLE_ABILITY
help: The target player can learn the ability: they meet the skill/race/class requirements from SkillLineAbility and do not know the spell yet. If an item is given, the player must also not own that item (inventory or bank) — intended for one-time ability-teaching items.

name: CONDITION_SKILL_BELOW
help: The target player has the skill and its base value is below (not equal to) the given value. Special case: with value 1, true when the player does not have the skill at all.

name: CONDITION_REPUTATION_RANK_MAX
help: The target player's reputation rank with the faction is at most the given rank.

name: CONDITION_COMPLETED_ENCOUNTER
help: The current dungeon has completed the given encounter (DungeonEncounter.dbc id). If a second encounter is given, either one satisfies the condition; both must belong to the same map. Only valid inside a dungeon.

name: CONDITION_LAST_WAYPOINT
help: Compares the source creature's last reached waypoint with the given id. 'Reached (>=)' is true when the creature has reached this waypoint or a later one; 'not yet reached (<)' when it has not reached it yet.

name: CONDITION_XP_USER
help: Checks whether the target player has experience gain disabled (0) or enabled (1).

name: CONDITION_GENDER
help: The target unit has the given gender.

name: CONDITION_DEAD_OR_AWAY
help: Checks death/absence. 0: the target player is dead or out of range. 1: all players of the target player's group are dead, GMs excluded, or out of range. 2: all players in the instance are dead or out of range. 3: the source creature is dead. The range (if non-zero) is measured from the source.

name: CONDITION_CREATURE_IN_RANGE
help: An alive creature with the given entry exists within range of the target. The range must be greater than 0.

name: CONDITION_PVP_SCRIPT
help: Asks the outdoor PvP script (or the battleground the target player is in) for the given zone whether the script-specific condition id is met.
description: pvp script in {pram1} {negate:satisfies|does not satisfy} condition {pram2}

name: CONDITION_SPAWN_COUNT
help: At least the given number of creatures with this entry are currently spawned on the map (taken from the source or target).

name: CONDITION_WORLD_SCRIPT
help: Asks the global world state script whether the hardcoded condition id is fulfilled with the given value. Needs no source or target.

name: CONDITION_WORLDSTATE
help: Compares a map-scoped worldstate variable with the operand using the given operator. The worldstate id must be a named worldstate known to the core. Operator 'none' always evaluates to true.

name: CONDITION_IS_IN_COMBAT
help: The target unit is in combat (0) or out of combat (1).
